target_authority.row_contract: canonical slug/market/condition, exact start/end/cutoff, official final outcome, UTC-hour cluster, split, raw Gamma SHA-256 and immutable staging locator

causality: use only exchange event_time_ns at or before the market decision_cutoff
latest aggregate-trade observations have a frozen maximum age of two seconds
one-second previous-tick grids have a frozen maximum staleness of two seconds
Coinbase observations use only complete 60-second buckets ending at or before cutoff
missing observations cause track-market exclusion without interpolation, lookahead or substitution
archive, acquisition and receipt times are provenance and never feature event time

exclusions_and_gaps.runtime_policy: any missing track observation fails closed for that track-market under the preregistration

linux_import: verify the four downloaded sizes and SHA-256 values against their content-addressed names and manifest.json
read target-cohort.jsonl in ascending order; do not add, remove or reorder rows
read authority-index.json and download each target_staging and external_staging asset by its authenticated asset_id into a transient Linux materialization directory
verify every staging asset state, byte size and SHA-256 from its content-addressed name before use
derive only the 16 frozen features from event_time_ns under the preregistered causal and missing-data rules
score only on Gamma/Linux; never use development outcomes to alter the frozen evaluation design

claim_boundary.tests: whether the frozen external-information families independently predict BTC 5-minute Up/Down outcomes
claim_boundary.pass_consequence: may authorize only an isolated experimental Ultra development track
claim_boundary.promotion_requirement: separate residual-midpoint evidence and all existing confirmation/promotion gates remain required
